data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 we released prior year reserves of $110.0m (2017: $176.9m). Our specialty lines division increased reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures. Specialty lines releases also included amounts from the cyber portfolio, an area that has more variability than the rest of the specialty lines account. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect of reduced margins on reserve releases, along with the effects of a large series of natural disasters, is now visible. Property has been significantly impacted by higher attritional claims, as well as some strengthening on the 2017 catastrophe estimates during the year. As a result property was the only division that had a strengthening of reserves for 2018 of $48.0m.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were $3,381.5m. The syndicate reports a net release of prior year reserves of $110.0m in 2018, driven largely by favourable development in the specialty lines portfolio as post-recession years (from 2012 onwards) mature and releases in the cyber portfolio. Offsetting items included adverse development in property driven by higher attritional claims and some strengthening of 2017 catastrophe estimates (property strengthening of $48.0m). The 2018 calendar year was also impacted by several natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami, California wildfires) which were material contributors to 2018 claims activity.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) at 1 Jan 2018. No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found; the report states a net prior year release of $110.0m which has been used as a fallback (NET of reinsurance). This is flagged as a net figure and used because no gross prior-year movement was explicitly reported. Property strengthening of $48.0m is explicitly stated and used. Mapping of 'specialty lines' to 'Professional Lines' is an interpretive mapping for the structured fields; amounts by LOB for prior year movement are not explicitly quantified except for Property.
